description.text: The eighth XY set, released on 4 November 2015 with 164 cards: 162 and two secret Mewtwo-EX. It brought in BREAK Evolution: a Pokémon BREAK is played on top of a Pokémon and adds an attack or Ability while keeping those it had; Zoroark BREAK is among the first six. Mega Mewtwo X and Mega Mewtwo Y lead its eight Pokémon-EX, and it draws Pokémon from every region.
